newsitem.title: UK: Oasis shares up after catalogue deal.
newsitem.headline: Oasis shares up after catalogue deal.

text.p: Oasis Stores Plc shares spiked higher in early trade on Monday after a weekend press report said the fashion retailer had signed a deal to have its designs featured in Otto Versand catalogues, dealers said.
The stock was up 17p to 242-1/2 by 0734 GMT.
The Sunday Telegraph said Oasis would receive a "small percentage" of sales for all orders taken from catalogues in both the UK and Germany. Versand is the world's largest home shopping company.
The paper quoted an Oasis executive as saying the move was mainly important as a step towards launching its own mail order business.
Oasis shares dropped sharply early last month after the company warned that its profits in the first half of the current financial year would be materially below the previous year.
